name: judge-codex
description: Autonomous + rigorous Codex-as-judge layer for the `plan` cycle ecosystem (DISCOVER → PLAN → IMPLEMENT → CODE-QUALITY → REVIEW). Breaks the Claude-only monoculture by adding GPT-Codex as an orthogonal LLM jury that re-validates each cycle's artifact against the cycle's golden-rule contract. Output is structured JSON aligned with the canonical verdict vocabulary (SHIPPABLE / SHIPPABLE_WITH_CAVEATS / NEEDS_FIXES / FAIL_HARD / INVALID) — not the binary approve/needs-attention used by generic code review.
_comment_: judge-codex is a sibling plugin to `plan` (https://github.com/paulohenriquevn/plan). It does NOT replace `plan`'s 5-7 Claude sub-agents; it adds Codex as an orthogonal LLM jury so substance findings are no longer monocultural. Inspired by openai/codex-plugin-cc (generic Codex CLI bridge) and paulohenriquevn/loop-code-review (Ralph-loop + Autoresearch keep/discard quality gates).
